explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/775: Gao [Ga25] proved that every k-uniform hypergraph (k ≥ 3) on n vertices has at most n − f_k(n) distinct clique sizes, with f_k(n) → ∞. The statement is the k = 3 case: ∃ f → ∞ with |cliqueSizes H| + f(n) ≤ n eventually, for all 3-uniform H on Fin n. cliqueSizes is the set of sizes of maximal complete vertex sets, i.e. the page's 'maximal complete subgraphs'. Faithful.
